question: JavaScript mein private fields kaise banate ho class mein?
options: #propertyName — hash prefix se private hota hai
explanation: Modern JS mein # prefix se truly private fields hain — class ke bahar access nahi hote. Underscore sirf convention hai (conventionally private), technically public rehta hai.

question: Factory function kya hota hai?
options: Ek function jo naya object return karta hai — new keyword nahi chahiye
explanation: Factory function: function call karo, naya object milega. Class ki tarah but without new keyword, without this confusion. Closures se private variables bhi bana sakte ho.

question: Singleton pattern kyun use hota hai?
options: Taaki sirf EK instance ho poore application mein
Bahut saare instances banane ke liye
Arrays ko manage karne ke liye
Functions ko optimize karne ke liye
explanation: Singleton: sirf ek instance exist karega. Configuration, database connection, logging — jahan ek hi instance chahiye. Class ya IIFE se bana sakte ho.

question: Module pattern ka kya fayda hai?
options: Public aur private dono cheezein expose karo — encapsulation
explanation: Module pattern (IIFE ya ES modules) se private variables/functions hidden rehte hain aur sirf public API exposed hoti hai. Information hiding — security aur clean API.

question: ES6 modules vs IIFE pattern — kaunsa better hai?
options: ES6 modules — built-in, clean syntax, tree-shaking support
explanation: ES6 modules (import/export) modern standard hain — built-in encapsulation, static analysis, tree-shaking. IIFE purana pattern hai but modules mein ab zaroorat nahi.
